findings.text: Source weights remain resident while copied tile and successive input rows produce separate output rows. Fetch accounting does not silently repeat for the second row.
findings.simulated_learner_critique: Can distinguish what is reused from what changes; scope makes the tiny resident tile assumption explicit.

findings.text: Backward computation and last-consumer activation release are distinct states. Byte strings and retained ownership remain legible in the narrow two-column activation pool.
findings.simulated_learner_critique: The starting point is explicitly end-forward; this explains the initial allocations without implying a full training trace.

findings.text: Four paired weighted contributions precede separate reduction and output write. Second reduction retains the committed accumulator while incoming values occupy a separate dock; input and shared kernel stay visible.
findings.simulated_learner_critique: A reader can trace a selected patch through products to its written output, then see the spatial shift with the same kernel.

findings.text: Each channel computes its own spatial intermediate before either output mixes across channels. Intermediate and output numbers match the calculator.
findings.simulated_learner_critique: The intermediates explain the factorization; no arbitrary numerical equality with a standard layer is asserted.

findings.text: Successive lowered rows copy from the retained input with declared source indices, then the completed matrix feeds GEMM. Dense narrow numeric values remain intact.
findings.simulated_learner_critique: Copying exposes duplication rather than pretending lowering is a free reshape.

findings.text: Prompt cache positions and Request A ownership remain visible during projection, non-destructive read copies, attention, append, and emission. Symbolic identities remain intact at narrow width.
findings.simulated_learner_critique: The current-pass chamber, persistent cache, and read copies answer different questions; the emitted token is not shown as cached before being consumed.

findings.text: All twelve addresses fit one continuous row. A/B/C/D owners and free styling remain distinguishable; release preserves reserved capacity and the blocked request preserves existing contents.
findings.simulated_learner_critique: Visible holes show why aggregate reusable capacity alone cannot satisfy the contiguous request under the declared fixed-pool policy.

findings.text: Host and device lanes advance through dependent eager work, then a single fused submission with equal arithmetic results. Abstract schedule units are explicitly scoped.
findings.simulated_learner_critique: The scene explains which host dependency disappears without presenting toy timings as measured performance.

findings.text: Actual successive reads populate persistent read trails through each layout’s physical addresses, with old storage values retained. Address labels survive responsive wrapping.
findings.simulated_learner_critique: The same logical row yields adjacent row-major offsets and strided column-major offsets; no cache transaction claim is needed.

findings.text: Earlier dense pool readability defects are resolved in this epoch: whole training byte strings, intact cache identities/ownership, and all twelve allocator addresses remain visible. Current native endpoint/motion frames were inspected.

Earlier CNN scalar-only and receiving-dock collision defects remain resolved: actual paired contributions, separate reduction/write, readable committed sum and incoming values are visible in the current native samples.

Secondary Incoming labels wrap inside dense cells during travel, particularly narrow scenes. Numeric payloads, prior rows, source values and destination identities remain readable; this is recorded without claiming polished single-line dock text.
Initial desktop-dark motion screenshot omitted the scene. It was rejected; the fresh full-height paused retake was manually inspected and substitutes for it.

manual_inspection.endpoint_method: Fresh actual-chapter captures for every authored base-case state in four profiles. All153 changed endpoints inspected through native scene crops/contacts (desktop pixels preserved at original resolution and narrow282px scene width), plus representative full-context frames. For103 full decoded-pixel matches, actual prior inspection was reused only after verifying the historical report contains that exact key/case/state/profile, PNG byte SHA256, and manual-inspection flag. Exact per-record flags below distinguish methods.
manual_inspection.motion_method: Fresh native Next, Pause, and Finish action samples for every owned lesson in all four profiles. Actual WAAPI times and retained committed index recorded; all36 accepted frames manually inspected at native resolution. One desktop-dark training frame omitted the scene and was rejected, then retaken after recomputing current figure geometry, expanding viewport height, and scrolling. Both captures preserved moving/paused state; only the complete retake is accepted. No asset interception, runtime overrides, or fake visibility events.
